title: Annotatio IV §.XX close: in sacrament SPIRITUALLY not corporally; Calixtus — they denied true-body presence — stop before §.XXI
pass_a_gloss: Let us hear them speaking…: But in the Sacraments, they say, is Christ’s Body… and hence it is that in the sacraments we profess Christ to be not PERSONALLY or CORPORALLY, or SENSIBLY to our senses and body, but only in the SPIRITUAL mode of being already said… everywhere SPIRITUALLY, namely by HIS POWER AND EFFICACY, HERE WORKING SALVATION FOR EVERY BELIEVER… Christ is present in the Sacrament NOT CORPORALLY and sensibly to our body, but in HIS SPIRITUAL MODE OF BEING… Nor is there cause for Ægidius Strauch… to say: It were to be wished we had the genuine Confession of the ancient Waldenses… For we have this too, at least in part, and that part we brought above in §. 16., diametrically opposed to the Lutheran Sentence. So that blessed Georg Calixtus seems moved by this very thing to write of the Waldenses, even if not sufficiently knowing their sentence: The Waldenses, he says, or Picards of Bohemia and Moravia, are known to have denied the presence of the true Body in the Eucharist.
pass_b_english: Hear them: in the sacraments Christ’s Body is present — not PERSONALLY, CORPORALLY, or SENSIBLY to our body, but only in the SPIRITUAL mode of being, by power and efficacy working salvation for every believer.

Strauch need not wish for an ancient Waldensian confession — we already have part of it above (§.16), diametrically against the Lutheran sentence; Calixtus notes the Bohemian/Moravian Picards denied true-Body presence in the Eucharist. Stop before §.XXI.
source_text: Audiamus illos loquentes…: In Sacramentis verò est, inquiunt, Corpus Christi… atque hinc est ut in sacramentis profiteamur Christum esse non PERSONALITER aut CORPORALITER, sive SENSIBILITER nostris sensibus ac corpori, sed solum essendi MODO jam dicto SPIRITUALI… utrobique SPIRITUALITER, POTENTIA SCIL. SUA AC EFICACIA, HIC OPERANDO SALUTEM OMNI CREDENTI… Christus adsit in Sacramento NON CORPORALITER ac sensibiliter corpori nostro, sed MODO ESSENDI SUO SPIRITUALI… Nec est cur Ægidius Strauchius… dicat: Optandum esse ut haberemus antiquorum Waldensium genuinam Confessionem… Nam & hanc, ex parte saltem, habemus, istamque partem adduximus suprà §. 16., Lutheranæ Sententiæ è diametro adversam. Ut permotus videatur hôc ipsô B. Georgius Calixtus…: Waldenses, inquit, sive Picardos Bohemiæ & Moraviæ, præsentiam veri Corporis in Eucharistia, negasse notum est.
